'''Wes Cobb''' played the [[2007 Corellia Regionals]]. On the Players Committee forum he posted as davidson07; his signature there reads "Co-reincarnator of Team Louisville".<ref name="sf-20765-299624">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=299624#p299624 The Official Corellia Regionals Thread], davidson07 (Wes Cobb), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (5 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125182549/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20765.html Internet Archive]</ref> In May 2008 he announced that the [[2008 Corellia Regionals]] (Saturday 26 July) and the [[2008 Indiana State Championship]] (Sunday 27 July) would be held on one weekend at GAMERZ in Greenwood, Indiana, with Paul Brothers directing both events.<ref name="sf-20765-299624" /> He finished 8th at the 2008 Kentucky State Championship (7 June 2008) and wrote a tournament report on DeckTech,<ref name="sf-21635-311852">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311852#p311852 tournament reports, etc], Throdo (Jonathan Murray), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (2 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192041/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21635.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref> and he and [[Chris Thompson]] received the Day 2 automatic bids to the [[2008 World Championship]] from the 2008 Corellia Regionals.<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
